name: PR/SET domain 14
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PRDM14 encodes PR domain zinc finger protein 14. Annotated molecular activities include RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and germ cell development.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
